artistBio:
KHROME is a Los Angeles–based DJ and producer moving between bounce, trance, and high-tempo club music — but more than genre, his work is rooted in community.

What pulls him to this sound isn’t just the pace or the distortion. It’s the feeling in the room. The way people loosen up. The way strangers turn into friends by the second drop. There’s a lightness to this culture — fast, playful, unpretentious — where the music feels physical but the energy feels welcoming.

His sets are built around that exchange. He reads the floor closely, adjusts in real time, lets moments breathe when they need to, then pushes when the room asks for it. Bounce rhythms, trance lifts, warped edits, and sharper textures all serve the same purpose: keeping people locked in together. Not watching — participating.

As a Resident DJ for Neo Bounce, KHROME has grown inside a scene that prioritizes movement and connection over image. He’s had the opportunity to close for headliners such as Andata and GEORGE (aka Dr. Radsport), and deliver direct support for Trancemaster Krause and Bababass3000 — experiences that reinforced his ability to hold space at different points in a lineup while staying true to his sound.

He’s worked alongside crews including Aftermidnight, LickNDip, SXTCY, Star Crossed, and Inland Groove, moving through warehouses and clubs across Southern California. Wherever the setting, the focus remains the same: people first. Music first. Shared energy over spectacle.

Influenced by Panteros666, ODYMEL, Ueberrest, Indira Paganotto, and the 240km/h movement, KHROME draws from the harder spectrum of club culture while keeping his sets playful and emotionally aware.

With new singles on the way and a debut EP in development, the intention isn’t just to grow bigger — it’s to build something lasting. A sound, a space, and a community that feels lighter, louder, and more alive every time the lights go down.
